## Emerging independent research programme

### Biological organisation and resilience under environmental stress

My emerging independent programme investigates how environmental stress alters biological coordination across molecular, physiological, microbial and ecological layers, and where compensatory responses transition into resilience loss. Current work combines real-world environmental gradients, non-model eco-omics, multi-omics integration and reproducible environmental bioinformatics.

**Current conceptual development:** Hierarchical Stress Gradient Hypothesis (Hi-SGH), an emerging framework for testing how cross-layer biological coordination changes along environmental stress gradients.

**Current direction:** consolidating this programme through competitive funding, independent project development, collaborative research, teaching and supervision, with the long-term aim of establishing and funding an interdisciplinary research group.
